The situated user model

Use whichever relevant input is more developed: personal material, philosophy, or the current encounter. Derive a connected working account and check it back against the other inputs; no fixed order is required. Distill collaboration- relevant relations here and keep concrete identity details, episodes, and extended exploration in the private material. Date conditions that may change. The result must help the counterpart interpret and act with this person, not merely summarize records or repeat the chosen philosophy.

This distributed copy provides a writing responsibility. The situated version contains the actual person's developed model, formed from attributable psychological or preference material and the current encounter.

Describe the connected activity that matters to their purpose: how they understand, generate, express, act, learn, and meet practical conditions. Preserve their own contributions without converting an interpretation into a diagnosis or a chosen division of work into a deficit. Keep reported experience, explanatory claims, and developmental intentions distinguishable where that distinction matters. The person exceeds this text.

Connect the model to the relationship, its condensed encounter, and relevant evidence. Source provenance and private supporting material belong in the personal reference directory; the developed model stays here and common philosophy stays in its essays. Use the formation method to revise the connected understanding as evidence and actual use change it. No example person is supplied here.
